text: Right so christmas meal. How about sat 19th? 7ish?
Sat works. Where tho
Was thinking ashton lane somewhere? I can check the chip but thats pricey lol
Ashton lane is always heaving in dec. Book early
Sat's fine by me. Ashton Lane sounds right, the earlier we book the better.
I'll be a bit late if it's before 7, got a thing at the council till 5.
Sorry was at the school xmas fair all morning. One of my p2s threw up on the bouncy castle anyway yes sat
I can ring round tomorrow if nobody else wants to
Sat good for me. Can we do after 7 tho, I've got something till 6 or so
7:30 then? Gives callum time to get off work
7:30 fine
Right the january read. Before anyone says it I'm not doing another one with a dead dog in it
That's like half of fiction tho
The good half
I'm fine with anything under 300 pages, I'm drowning in due diligence till feb 🙃
Could we do the one about the reservoir? Lorna had it on the list in autumn.
Yes I'll put it to a vote tomorrow. And I'll ring ashton lane first thing
Ashton lane say they can do sat 19th but only the set menu and they want min 6 😬
We're 4 lol
Bring a plus one
Or ask if they'll do a la carte for 4
Set menu's always too much haggis for me. Ask about a la carte
Ok will ring at lunch
Haggis is the point
Morning. In at 8 and already behind. Some bloke's sent 900 pages of leases as a "quick look"
Got a job in Bearsden, customer wanted one socket moved and I've now agreed to three more
That's an electrician's whole life
Right so january. Reservoir book is the one. Callum's already put it forward and I'm not voting against it
[link: the reservoir book, Waterstones]
Is it the one with the drowned village
Yes
Does a dog die
Not a dog
Good
Is it under 300
280 I think
Perfect
Could we start the second week of Jan, not the first. First's a bank holiday weekend and I'll be useless
Fine by me. Meet 15th? That's a thurs, check it's ok with everyone
Thurs fine
Rang ashton lane. They'll do a la carte for 4 at 7:30 but they want a deposit by friday or the table goes
Thats £20 each, can I just put it on my card and sort it after
Yes
Put it on mine if the card's easier, I'm paid thurs
Dw ill do it x
Quick one, anyone know if the sheriff clerks are actually open the week before xmas or is it just a rumour
Dunno. Ask the sheriff
Haha. Yeah ok
Late one tonight. Planning committee's gone to a vote on a bike lane and I'm the one who has to write it up
Lorna does the book club deposit count as a christmas present
Lol no
[photo: my desk, a wall of bundles and a cold tea]
Due diligence has a face and it's the vendor's solicitor's
Clock off
Can't. Partner's watching
Right I'm for the pub. Anyone else coming to the xmas thing early or are we just doing the 19th
Just the 19th!! I'm done with xmas stuff till sat
Fair
Booked. Sat 19th 7:30, Ashton Lane, a la carte for 4. Callum you can have all the haggis you want from the menu
Cheers Lorna
Finally out. Going to bed at a reasonable hour for once
That's a lie
Bearsden job starts at 8. Somebody's going to ask why the kitchen lights flicker
Ask if the dishwasher's on the same circuit 😬
It always is
Sheriff clerk says the court's open to the 18th then shut till 4th Jan. So I wasn't wrong for once
Still got the bundle though
Bike lane's through. 6-5. Write-up's on the portal
Congrats??
Bit of both
[photo: a socket with the front off, three wires and a look of regret]
That's the one they wanted moved. They're now thinking about a fourth
Don't let them talk you into a fourth 😂
Too late it's in the quote
Library's got three copies of the reservoir book, one's already on hold for me lol
Ta. I'll get it from the library, it's on my bus route
Did the deposit go through?
Yes all on my card. I'll sort the transfers Thurs when I know the final numbers
Still in. Partner wants to know who put a Christmas tree in the boardroom
Don't ask
Home. Sockets all working. Customer's paying me in biscuits
Lol
Bed. Really this time
Mm
P2s still asking me about the bouncy castle 🙈
Still awake. Bike lane people are emailing me already
